content: GIFT is a plain-text, Moodle-associated interchange format for MC/TF/short-answer/matching/numerical questions, human-writable in a text editor. QTI (IMS Question and Test Interoperability) is an XML-based standard for exchanging assessment content/results across many LMSs (Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, Sakai...); more structurally complete but far heavier to implement than GIFT.
